Resolves #21712

A board card now keeps its shape while it is edited. During the inline title edit, the card keeps its height and the name keeps the title's font and position, in all five themes. In the card editor, every text-like field now has its label on top, as the native status select already had, so the dialog reads as one form. A config that names its own `labelPosition` keeps it, and subclasses can change the rule through `CardEditor#labelOnTop`.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright unit + component + e2e, headless Chromium) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/board/CardInlineEditShape.spec.mjs` measures the card's height and the name's font and text start, before and during the edit. On dev's CSS it fails on the height (62.19 → 67 px). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `CardEditor.spec.mjs` "every text-like field labels on top, as the status select does, unless its config names its own side". It covers seven standard fields and a model field, and checks that a named `left` stays. It fails on dev. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `SelectionModel.spec.mjs` "Space, Shift+Up/Down, Click, …": a `⋯` click on a selected card keeps `['b1','b2','b3']`, and on the unselected `p1` makes it the selection. It fails on dev. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the board unit family and `test/playwright/e2e/board/`. Local runs: unit 175/175, component 3/3, e2e 32/32. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The field starts 5 px left of the title (its border and padding), so the name doesn't shift sideways as the edit begins. Measured: the text starts at the same x, and the field still stops before the `⋯` button.
- The helper is a protected method, `labelOnTop`. The class-module-scope guard refuses module-scope functions, and a method lets an app keep left labels by overriding it.
- Added after a cold read of #21630's frames: the `⋯` selection rule (AC-3, now in the ticket), and the board's focus ring on the inline name field, where some themes' field borders barely show. The ring is set through `--textfield-outline-active`, because a focused field paints its input's outline from that variable with `!important`. `CardInlineEditShape.spec.mjs` asserts it in that state.

## Test Evidence

The card's height before → during an inline edit on `board/basic` at 1440 × 900:

| theme | dev | head |
|---|---|---|
| neo-dark | 63.11 → 67.92 | 63.11 → 63.11 |
| neo-light | 63.11 → 67.92 | 63.11 → 63.11 |
| dark, light, cyberpunk | — | 63.11 → 63.11 |

`board/basic` in neo-dark, whole page at 1440 × 900: the first card's inline title edit, then its card editor. Dev is `6f3d7c2243`, and head is `65037314f9`. The frames live on the evidence ref `grace/21712-review-frames` at `70eed569fa`, which is not this PR's head.

| dev | head |
|---|---|
| ![dev: the edited card grows, and its name loses the title's type](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/70eed569fa340030aadb0bc8863a255cebaed8f5/review-evidence/21712/inline-dev-neo-dark.png?raw=true) | ![head: the card keeps its height, and the name its type, inside the board's focus ring](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/70eed569fa340030aadb0bc8863a255cebaed8f5/review-evidence/21712/inline-head-neo-dark.png?raw=true) |
| ![dev: Description and Status labelled on top, the rest on the left](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/70eed569fa340030aadb0bc8863a255cebaed8f5/review-evidence/21712/editor-dev-neo-dark.png?raw=true) | ![head: every label on top](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/70eed569fa340030aadb0bc8863a255cebaed8f5/review-evidence/21712/editor-head-neo-dark.png?raw=true) |

Frame critique: on dev, the edited card grows by 4.8 px and pushes its column down, the name drops to the field's smaller, lighter type, and the focused field shows no ring (measured outline `none`). The editor mixes two label sides. Head fixes all of these. The field's ring measures `solid 2px rgb(94, 234, 212)`, the theme's board focus color. The editor is taller with labels on top (666 against 543 px), and it stays centred in the 900 px window. Still visible, and kept: the ring sits 1 px outside the field's own active border, and inside the focused card's ring, so the edited name shows three edges. Each one marks a different state. Outside this ticket: the dialog header keeps the theme's maximize button, and the status select keeps its native grey beside the text fields. Both are the same on dev.

On the non-blocking `focusedKey` note: `onCardFocusIn` (`SelectionModel.mjs:496`, delegated `focusin` on `.neo-board-card`) moves `focusedKey` whenever focus enters a card, including a `⋯` button that a click focuses.
